name: The Chill Gorillas
summary: Our game is like other gorilla tag fan games although we merge them together to create The Chill Gorillas. We hope that you will enjoy playing our game and if not, you can join our discords and give us suggestions, but you never know, it might get selected! We use advanced items specially made and chosen for you to enjoy we are a small community mod applications are currently open. We hope that you and anyone else that plays has a great time!
